title: wavelet-release-controller-with-telemetry-failsafe-and-shadow-synthesis
author: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Motivation: introduce a small-footprint, phase-synchronized 'Wavelet' release controller that provides smoother staged cutovers for model rollouts while enabling an automated telemetry-backed failsafe path and a local shadow-synthesis mode for dry-run validation. This PR implements the controller, a lightweight harbor adapter for controlled traffic staging, and observability hooks required by the Ops playbook.

What this change does (summary): add a new controller (wavelet_release_controller) that coordinates mini-phases (wavelets) rather than monolithic canaries; exposes a control API to declare phase plans; integrates a telemetry safety scorer (safety_score) that can trigger immediate rollback when multiple metric anchors cross configured thresholds; implements shadow synthesis – a mode that runs live-traffic inference through a synthetic drain and compares outputs to the promoted model without affecting production responses; introduces a 'harbor' buffer for steady ramping and drain windows; updates Helm chart and adds e2e smoke tests for staged promotes and failsafe execution.

Why this approach: many teams see sharp step-promotes cause transient latencies and consumer-visible regressions when serving capacity or KV state differs between variants. Wavelet phases reduce amplitude of traffic change and the telemetry scorer provides deterministic, explainable abort criteria tied to latency/error/quality anchors. Shadow synthesis enables deterministic pre-promotion regressions to be surfaced in the release timeline.

Checklist:
- [x] Core controller implementation (Go) with unit tests
- [x] Harbor adapter (Python) for rate-limited ingress shaping
- [x] Telemetry scorer and metric adapters wired into console dashboards
- [x] Helm chart adjustments for new CRD and policies
- [x] e2e smoke harness (CI) and integration tests for rollback path
- [x] Docs: rollout playbook and SDK examples for declarative phase plans

Migration notes: default behavior preserves existing rollout semantics; new controller is opt-in via CRD manifest. Existing promote APIs continue to function; cluster operators can flip a feature flag in the namespace to route promotes through the Wavelet controller.

Related work: ENG-3821 (rollout smoothing spike mitigation), ENG-3899 (shadow validation standardization). See internal design doc: https://linear.redwood.example/ENG-3821 (internal).

Testing: unit tests for controller state machine, mocked telemetry scorer unit tests, integration test that runs a synthetic shadow-synthesis job and validates abort on an injected latency regression. CI matrix ran on Go 1.21 + Python 3.11.

Risks & mitigations: the autonomous rollback path has a conservative cooldown to avoid oscillation; we added a human-latch mode to require manual confirmation for production-critical namespaces. If the telemetry scorer misfires due to noisy upstream metrics, operators can temporarily promote via the legacy controller.

Merge notes: squash merge to keep history focused and make revert straightforward if needed.

review_comments: Daniel Kim (2026-02-19): Nice work. A few nits: please split the large Reconcile() into smaller private helpers for readability; also add a comment explaining the backoff choice in steady ramp; otherwise LGTM.

Aisha Kapoor (2026-02-19): replied: refactored Reconcile() into reconcilePlan(), reconcilePhase() and reconcileMetrics(); added comment explaining exponential backoff cap tuned to 30s per the design doc.

Marcel Duarte (2026-02-20): Concern: safety_scorer uses a simple weighted sum. Can we add a minimum per-anchor guard so a single metric can't dominate? Also add unit tests for noisy metrics (flaky sensors).
Aisha Kapoor (2026-02-20): replied: added per-anchor floor thresholds and extended safety_scorer unit tests to include noisy sensor simulation; documented the rationale in the scorer comment block.
Sofia López (2026-02-22): Can the shadow-synthesis job be limited to a sample fraction to control cost? Suggest adding a helm value for synth_sample_rate.
Aisha Kapoor (2026-02-22): replied: added helm value synthSampleRate with default 0.02 and exposed SDK flag to override per-run for higher coverage during dry-runs.
Marcel Duarte (2026-02-23): Integration tests flaky on one CI run due to timing. Suggest making test timeouts slightly more generous and re-run CI.
Aisha Kapoor (2026-02-23): replied: increased timeouts, added a stability check that tolerates transient drops if they recover within phase window; re-ran CI.
release_notes: Introduce Wavelet release controller: phased wavelets for smoother model promotes, telemetry-backed safety scorer with automatic rollback, shadow-synthesis mode for dry-run validation, harbor ingress buffer for steady ramps. Opt-in via CRD and helm values. Includes docs and e2e smoke tests.
